'''Kuna's Eye''' was a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|same name]], located within the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]]. It was less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane, within the [[thin disk]] and the [[Inner Zuma Region]]. In [[43 ABY]], it was still relatively young and was surrounded by a [[Unidentified protoplanetary disk|protoplanetary disk]], which contained [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], metals, and alloys. The parent system of Kuna's Eye was frequented by prospectors, whose needs were served by the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] known as the [[Mote]].

==Description==
The [[Star/Legends|star]] Kuna's Eye was a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] in the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye system]],<ref name="TEA" /> located at [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] coordinates H-16 in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]] of the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="teaoc" /> It was located less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] above the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane within the [[thin disk]]&mdash;which extended 1,000 light-[[Standard year/Legends|years]] above and below the plane&mdash;thus making it a part of the [[Inner Zuma Region]]. Kuna's Eye, along with the other Kuna [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], formed part of the [[Kuna constellation]] that was visible from the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Members of two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] and the [[Jinda/Legends|Jindas]], intended to colonize the Kuna's Eye [[Star system/Legends|system]] from the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] circa [[130 BBY]], but their [[Starship/Legends|colony ship]], the ''[[Free Enterprise]]'', crashed on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="CoE">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>

As of [[43 ABY]], the star was still relatively young and was surrounded by a [[Unidentified protoplanetary disk|protoplanetary disk]] that was rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]],<ref name="TEA" /> metals, and alloys.<ref name="gamer9" /> Prospectors frequented the area, their needs served by the [[Mote]], a cobbled-together<ref name="TEA" /> [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="gamer9" /> and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] at the edge of the disk,<ref name="TEA" /> near the system's periphery.<ref name="gamer9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuna's Eye and its system were introduced in the "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]" article&mdash;authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Jason Fry]]&mdash;in [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]], which was released on [[March 1]], [[2002]].<ref name="gamer9" /> They were later mentioned in the article "[[Castaways of Endor]]," written by Wallace and [[Robin Pronovost]] and released on [[December 1]], [[2008]], on [[StarWars.com]] for the members of the website's registration-exclusive fanclub, [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]],<ref name="CoE" /> which has since been retired.<ref name="hypretired">{{SWArchive|url=fans/news/hyperspace2010/index.html|text=Last Chance to Order the 2010 Hyperspace Member Kit!}}</ref> The star and the system were later given an entry and placed on a map in the [[2009]] [[Del Rey]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by Wallace and Fry, in the "A Closer Look: Endor and the Moddell Sector" chapter. This section gives a brief description of several astronomical objects, planets, and stars in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and supplies historical references and illustrations.<ref name="TEA" />

Some confusion surrounds the sectoral location of the star. ''The Essential Atlas'' states that it is located in the Moddell subsector, which is said to be a freestanding subsector,<ref name="TEA" /> while the newer [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] says that the Moddell is a subsector of the Zuma sector.<ref name="teaoc" /> This article assumes that the information from the Online Companion is correct.
